issues.title: Support re-attaching webviews to a dummy parent when detached
issues.body:
In order to keep the webview attached all time, a new prop `temporaryParentNodeTag` is introduced. When the webview is unmounted, the internal webview is remounted under the temporary parent.

Tested on iOS and Android

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1707258/212413190-48a2599b-048a-4877-bae2-537d13b64bea.mp4

issues.title: [ios] do not loop inaudible audio for silent switch hack
issues.body:
~~it seems like looping audio doesn't seem to be necessary~~

~~when the audio track is not looped, I don't see a bunch of worker threads being spawned to play the audio~~

Instead of looping the inaudible audio, the audio is played every 2 seconds and when the app is foregrounded. I couldn't find a way to know when the WkWebView audio session category changes, as it would be better to play the audio element only when needed.

issues.title: [android] Add rebind method
issues.body:
The goal is to add an imperative method for immediately swapping the webview to a different parent. This is helpful for race conditions where it's necessary to prevent the webview's document visibility to stay 'visible'.

There are some changes in this PR to enable this functionality:

1) adds a `rebind` method to re-attach the internal webview to the parent
2) instead of attaching the webview on setWebViewKey, we attach the webview when the window is attached
3) the view layout is not correct when it's rebound to a different view. we remeasure the view when the hierarchy changes

We'll do the iOS pr right after. The changes are just split out for ease of review. Apologies for the changes on the native side, I think there are some existing formatting issues

issues.title: fix bug where navigation delegate stops working after reusing WKWebView
issues.body: I was trying to make a button-click in the web page in the WebView conditionally load an iframe. Loading the iframe successfully depends on the navigation delegate as I learned from https://stackoverflow.com/questions/41250162/wkwebview-not-loading-content-from-iframe-on-a-webpage , and I realized the navigation delegate wasn't getting reconnected properly when attaching the WKWebView to a new RNCWebView. See additional context in https://github.com/react-native-webview/react-native-webview/pull/2469/files#r1026979105 .

issues.title: remove white background color flash on WebView
issues.body:
The background style on the `WebView` react component wasn't propagating to the internal WebView, so this PR
- applies the RNCWebView background color (which should be the same as the CSS background color in React) to the InternalWebView
and
- defaults the InternalWebView background color to transparent
